meta.name: Project 9191
meta.description:
A special Mumbai team, led by JCP Amitabh Sinha, works to prevent crimes by acting on tips from citizens and intercepted messages

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Only One Month
videos.overview: After repeated failures of the Unit 9191, Amitabh bargains for more time. He is given an ultimatum of one month to show a real case and reason to continue with the unit. Will the Unit 9191 be successful in decoding two calls that they receive just before Independence Day!

videos.title: Success or Failure?
videos.overview: Unit 9191 is on the edge chasing Hasan and Sajid, who have come to Mumbai from Uttar Pradesh. Also, chasing Rajesh Sharma alias Jamaal Khan, who has absconded after the Unit 9191 traced him. Will they be successful or fail once again?

videos.title: Dangerous Chemical
videos.overview: The unit is busy tracing two college students Rishabh and Kunal who are probably on a run with dangerous chemicals. Is there another Acid Attack being planned, similar to Swati Purohit’s acid attack, whose culprits are still at large? Meanwhile, Jamaal and Sunaina are spotted in Surat. What exactly are they up to?

videos.title: New Message Intercepted!
videos.overview: Will the revenge attack on Ajay and Nagesh be averted? Will the unit taste a second success in 2 days? The unit still hovers with questions about Jamaal and Sunaina, and they get a surprising call from Jamaal. Amidst all this, a message from Delhi is intercepted concerning an elderly couple from Amsterdam citing danger. What will Unit 9191 do?

videos.title: Surrender
videos.overview: Pankaj has backstabbed the unit. Will Amitabh be successful in getting to Jamaal surrender safely? Arfia has received an abduction alert video. Is there any ransom attached? Is this a regular kidnapping or a planned crime? A strange ransom letter reaches Bipin Parekh’s house in Mumbai.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Bipin is taken to task by the Unit. Is he the conspirator of the crime or he is just following orders? Will the unit be able to save Razia and Niyazzuddin Siddiqui. Jhalan’s pressure on Amitabh keeps increasing for updates on Jamaal and Sunaina. A Medical store owner dials 9191 and reports suspicious buying of a prohibited over-the-counter drug. Who is this strange individual?

videos.title: Who Is the Mastermind?
videos.overview: Did Nitin poison the midday meal at the school? The technical team is on toes searching for Ristazone purchase across Mumbai. Sharad faces CBI inquiry for his fake encounter suspension. There is someone who is ready to backstab Amitabh and his Unit 9191 in disclosing the location of Jamaal and Sunaina. Who is the mole within the team who has BETRAYED the Unit?
